question: In February 2020, Maria Sharapova announced her retirement from _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**tennis**__.

__
 
• In February 2020, **Maria Sharapova** announced her retirement from **tennis**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Maria Yuryevna Sharapova** is a **Russian** former professional **tennis player.**
 
• Although she played under the banner of Russia with the Women's Tennis Association.
 
• She has lived in and been a United States permanent resident since 1994. 
 
• **Sharapova** became the **world No. 1** for the **first time** on** 22 August 2005.**
 
• At the age of 18, becoming the **first Russian female tennis player** to top the **singles**
 
 
• **​Career end:** 26 February 2020
 
• **Grand slams won (singles): 5**
 
• **Wimbledon:** 2004‎
 
• **US Open:** 2006
 
• **Australian Open:** 2008
 
• **French Open: **2012‎, ‎2014‎
 
• **Nationality:** Russian
